text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the 'Track & Field Meet' is coming up 
soon, huh. Always a fun tradition.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking that the Twinkle 
Series alone wasn't enough running for me. 
Guess I'll go wild over here too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her classmates were already beginning to 
make a name for themselves. Narita Brian 
had already claimed four victories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon proved just as formidable. 
She crushed the graded race, utterly 
overwhelming the field.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The “Discipline-Specific Athletic Meet”... 
Let's see... It's a festival event where 
every student at Tracen Academy can 
participate in whatever race they like.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I want to enter too! So I can get 
stronger as fast as possible!
choice_data_list: Alright... In that case, let's enter!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To catch up with the leaders, Biko Pegasus 
enters the race as well. —And then came 
race day.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Gegeh?! That's... Hishi Ama-neesan!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
No way, Big Sis Hishi Ama is running? 
Impossible~. Maybe I should just 
withdraw...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What's going on here? Every single one of 
you looks pale as a ghost. Pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't there any fierce competitor here 
who wants to take me down? We're all 
Umamusume here, aren't we?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Biko-chan... It looks like 
everyone's giving up before the race has 
even started."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono was right. The other 
Umamusume were cowering like small fish 
before a catfish...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I feel like a dark aura is 
spreading around... It feels just like 
Hishi Ama-neesan's zone...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It is scary, isn't it? I'm scared too. If 
I ran alongside her, I feel like I'd get 
turned into simmered silver-stripe round 
herring~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus was equally terrified. It 
seemed like there was no one left who 
could stand up to them, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: It really is scary... It's scary, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, a hero never forgets their 
courage, right?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm... gonna do it! I'm gonna run! 
Even if my opponent is Hishi Ama-neesan!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, give me... power! The power to 
face down the strongest opponents.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOO!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Changing clothes and psyching myself up. 
Just like that, my hero mode switch gets 
flipped.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If no one else can do it, I'll do it 
myself!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So, nobody's willing to take me on 
one-on-one? Isn't there anyone with some 
real guts around here?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —I'm right here!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Toh! Justice Biko has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I have nothing to fear! Let's have a fair 
and square match!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Biko...? You've got good eyes, don't ya.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit. Alright, let's take 
this one-on-one!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus vs. Hishi Amazon. The 
showdown between the little hero and the 
ferocious queen had begun!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: HRAAAAAAAAA--!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There are only 8 runners! This'll be a 
piece of ca—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wha—Biko?! With that tiny body, you're 
right alongside me?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(Don't be scared! Don't fear! As long as I 
can beat Sis Hishiama...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She pulled up right alongside Hishi 
Amazon. The pressure must be immense, 
but... she's not letting herself be 
overwhelmed in spirit.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All that's left... is the timing for my 
special move...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —!? Already, at this point!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The green light is given much earlier 
than usual. Hishi Amazon is slightly boxed 
in on the inside."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If I break away now, I can win!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOH--!! Pegasus Rapid Arrowwwww!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Goal! Biko Pegasus takes first place! 
Hishi Amazon comes in second!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Oooooohh!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing! Biko-chan, you did 
iiit!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A brilliant move, and a massive upset. 
Biko Pegasus dealt a stunning defeat to 
none other than Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Biko... You...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, my eyes must be getting clouded. I 
had all my attention on Brian, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"To think someone so strong and promising 
was right by my side the whole time."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, whether I'm strong or not, I still 
don't know yet. But...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Heart wouldn't lose. After all, she's a 
hero!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's go one-on-one again. Next 
time, in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Did you see thaaat?! Trainer! Bono!
choice_data_list: Ah, that was a magnificent spurt!
Yeah, that was an incredible spurt!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, and it's all thanks to you giving 
me the signal at the perfect moment, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's why I was able to take the plunge 
and go all out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Biko-chan, you gave me... you gave me 
courage too...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't even had my Debut yet, and 
since I'm big, getting ready takes quite a 
bit of time, but..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I have to do my best just like Biko-chan. 
To make tomorrow buono."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Bono can do it! After all, she's my 
best friend...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh!? Uuu...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly clutching his leg, Biko Pegasus 
crouched down in pain. Hoisting his small 
frame, I dashed straight into the nurse's 
office.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: —It's just mild inflammation.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
It appears she put a little too much 
strain on her legs. She should rest for 
two to three days.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah……

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
"Her legs haven't always been the 
strongest to begin with. Please keep an 
eye on her, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I got careless. Just because she's gotten 
used to turf lately, I let her run far too 
freely...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Turf aptitude, but leg concerns." Biko 
Pegasus was, through and through, a hero 
forged in adversity.
choice_data_list: Sorry for pushing you so hard, Biko……
Sorry for working you so hard, Biko……

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's no big deal, so don't worry! 
Besides...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Things like this are a classic hero 
staple, you know.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You can't just spam your ultimate 
moves. You always have to sacrifice 
something in return.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I won't let fear stop me. I'll 
pick my moment, and when the time comes, 
I'll go all in with everything I've got!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Being able to do that is exactly what 
makes a hero! So you should do the same as 
me, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
When the going gets tough, put on a grin! 
That's how I managed to beat Big Sis 
Hishiama!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Encouraged by Biko Pegasus, I smiled. 
Although there was a bit of a price to 
pay—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus defeated the great Hishi 
Amazon, making her strongly acknowledge 
her as a true rival.
